The insurance market will be strengthened

through the South East European and Caucasus

Catastrophic Risk Insurance Facility (US$5

million) that will help increase access of

homeowners, farmers, the enterprise sector and

government agencies to financial protection from

losses caused by climate change and geological

hazards.

Local development is assisted through the

Municipal Services Improvement Project (US$25

million), which is helping to improve

transparency, financial sustainability and delivery

of targeted municipal services in selected

municipalities.

The World Bank is also active in the human

development sector through the Conditional Cash

Transfer Project (US$25 million).

Analytical and Advisory Activities (AAA)
